title: fix: replace pnpm/action-setup@v6 with corepack in all CI workflows
body:
CI workflows fail with `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE` due to `pnpm/action-setup@v6`'s npm-based self-installer misparsingthe lockfile. Applied the same fix used in [framework#1122](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1122).

### Changes

**Replaced `pnpm/action-setup@v6` → `corepack enable` across all 9 workflows:**

```yaml
# Before
- name: Setup pnpm
  uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
  with:
    version: 10.31.0

# After
- name: Enable Corepack
  run: corepack enable

- name: Verify pnpm version
  run: pnpm --version
```

**Updated workflows:**
- `ci.yml` (4 jobs: test, build, e2e, docs)
- `lint.yml`
- `release.yml`
- `changeset-release.yml`
- `performance-budget.yml`
- `shadcn-check.yml`
- `storybook-deploy.yml`
- `storybook-tests.yml`
- `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`

Corepack reads the `packageManager` field from `package.json` (`pnpm@10.31.0`) with SHA-512 verification, ensuring identical binaries between local dev and CI environments.
